name: draw-and-learn
description: Draw & Learn — a joyful tracing game for toddlers (shapes, letters, numbers). Static web app + Capacitor Android wrapper.

scripts.android:add: npm run www && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
